Notes

  • Their face is covered in acne scars, not freckles.
  • Quin's hair is curly and might be greasy.
  • They're remarkably more confident as Mysterio. Without the suit, they're a nervous people-pleasing wreck.
  • His glasses and clothes are probably dirty.
  • His entire body's hairy, not just his face.
  • Very, very sweaty. Sweat literally drips off of his hands when he's nervous.
  • Malnourished. Forgets to eat a lot.
  • His skin is kind of desaturated-looking.

Trivia

  • His favorite food is berry fruit snacks.
    They can feel your judgement. Stop that.
  • He named himself after his fantasy TTRPG character. Gets extremely pissed when people make fun of his name because he loves said character so, so much.
  • Didn't have much to do as a kid, so he would spend hours and days making and perfecting his own games.
  • Absolutely ADORES tabletop games. Cards, eh. Not so much.
  • Surprisingly not as into video games as people would think. He likes them, but not as much as tabletop.
  • You know how nerds sometimes say they see girls as a different, exotic species because they're so alien to them? Quin's like that but with all humans. He doesn't get humanity at all and genuinely has believed himself to be a different type of creature multiple times.
  • Doesn't have set meals because he 1) is very specific about texture, 2) forgets to eat often, and 3) doesn't enjoy eating most of the time unless it's the <10 foods he likes.
  • To combat this, he eats one 2000 calorie sasusage-vegetable pizza every day. He hates this immensely, but it solves the food problem.
  • They eat fruit snacks on special occasions or awful terrible no-good days as a treat.
  • Only really leaves his room if he has to go to work.
  • Has contemplated moving several times to smaller areas, but he's not sure what's worse: having a mental break due to overstimulation or disruption of familiarity.
